audience: food safety and facility teams that watch fridges, rooms and storage with DicksonOne loggers

useCases.title: Review active alerts by location and severity
useCases.text: List the active alerts, filtered by location or severity. Read the locations to find the ids to filter by, and count the alerts by severity.

useCases.title: Read the comments on an alert
useCases.text: List the alerts and pick one. Then read the comments that users added to that alert, with author and time.

useCases.title: Find a data logger and its alerts
useCases.text: List the data loggers on the account, optionally with archived or replaced ones. Use a logger token to filter the alerts of that logger.

useCases.title: Acknowledge an alert after you handle it
useCases.text: Read the alert and its comments first. Then acknowledge it. An alert that is already acknowledged returns an error and nothing changes.
